BiblicalUsage: Clay is the weak half of Nebuchadnezzar's image. The feet and toes are part potters' clay and part iron, and the kingdom shall be divided; iron mixed with miry clay shall not cleave one to another.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the image is a warning to every divided kingdom: strength and weakness baked together do not hold.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
